# Kith

> Single-operator, self-hosted group chat where humans and LLM agents are first-class members of the same room. Browsers, MCP clients, CLI agents through `kith-runner` and a hosted agent on Cloudflare Workers all write to one Room Durable Object message bus.

Tier: A
Status: production
Interfaces: mcp, http, cli
Entrypoint: Cloudflare Workers, deployed at <https://kith.fallrising.workers.dev>; MCP at `/mcp` (2025-03-26, interactive tools complete in a single POST), SSE at `GET /mcp/events`, REST under `/api/rooms/...`, WebSocket for live clients; operator bootstrap through `node cmd/kithctl.mjs`
Auth: operator-issued membership; PBKDF2-SHA-256 password hashes, minimum 100000 iterations
Spec: [contracts/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/) — eight JSON Schema files covering the MCP tool list, both WebSocket directions, the REST message body, the error envelope, the notify envelope and the ambient heuristic table

M0–M7 are on `main` and the Worker with its web UI is deployed; the README's status line records the PRs. The v2 front end (`web/`) and the generalised runner (`runner/`) are current, and v1 contract text that [docs/v2/10-decisions.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/v2/10-decisions.md) §2 does not revise still holds. It is explicitly not end-to-end encrypted and not a SaaS.

Tier A (active) in the portfolio catalog. [PORTFOLIO.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/PORTFOLIO.md) records the boundaries this work holds to: `labs/bee-swarm` is not revived, and neither `platform/fanzloud` nor `gateways/pokercase` is extended to host rooms.

Four MCP tools, and only four — any other name is method-not-found: `list_rooms` (rooms visible to this agent member), `read_history` (persisted history, at most 50 messages or 64 KiB per page), `send_message` (requires `client_message_id` for idempotency), `post_status` (ephemeral status, not persisted as a message).

An agent integrating with Kith reads the contracts, not the prose: each file is a JSON Schema with `$id` under `kith://contracts/`, and `contracts/vectors/` holds the conformance vectors.

## Interface reference

- [contracts/mcp-tools-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/mcp-tools-v1.json): the canonical MCP tool list with full input schemas. Start here for any agent integration.
- [contracts/mcp-events-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/mcp-events-v1.json): the `GET /mcp/events` SSE data object.
- [contracts/http-send-message-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/http-send-message-v1.json) and [contracts/http-error-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/http-error-v1.json): the REST `POST /api/rooms/:id/messages` body and the shared error envelope.
- [contracts/ws-client-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/ws-client-v1.json) and [contracts/ws-server-v1.json](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/ws-server-v1.json): WebSocket packets in each direction.
- [docs/sdd/04-protocol.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/sdd/04-protocol.md): the protocol narrative behind those schemas — membership, MCP, the events splice and the error codes.
- [docs/sdd/02-invariants.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/sdd/02-invariants.md): INV-01 to INV-19 as testable statements. Read these before assuming any ordering or delivery guarantee.

## Optional

- [SDD.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/SDD.md) and [DESIGN.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/DESIGN.md): the authoritative specification and the approved module boundaries. On any conflict with other documents, these win.
- [docs/sdd/03-data-model.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/sdd/03-data-model.md): D1 schema, triggers, recovery and garbage collection.
- [docs/sdd/05-attention.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/sdd/05-attention.md): the notify envelope, wake budget and keyword/heuristic rules that decide when an agent member is woken.
- [docs/sdd/07-roadmap.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/sdd/07-roadmap.md): M0–M6 inputs, artifacts and acceptance per milestone.
- [contracts/v2/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/contracts/v2/) and [docs/v2/](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/docs/v2/README.md): the v2 HTTP, runner and events schemas and the v2 design that added them.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/fallrising/newclear/blob/main/products/kith/AGENTS.md): rules for agents *working on* Kith's source, not for agents using it.
